controls: Each case starts from the same parent, current R=(2,0), goal (4,0), original wall (3,0), four-neighbor unit cost. Add exactly ONE bottom-row wall at (choice-1,1). Cases 3/4/5 are separate, never cumulative.
method: For each case, check the parent's returned route on the edited map, run fresh A* FIFO budget 30 and separate text-grid BFS. Compare outcomes to the student prediction only for choices 3/4/5. Parent raw data is reused, not rerun.
attribution: Student nominated 3/4/5 as any sufficient wall choice on the offered map before execution; no reason or expansion count supplied. AI adds 1/2 as controls without inferring a student forecast for them, and supplies configuration, runner, operation and validation.
scope: Five related single-wall variants of one synthetic parent, not independent random maps or physical robot trials. No incremental replanning or automatic obstacle detection.
